span.p:
T0 — Pattern
per-file, single-line regex + vetted structural matchers
e.g. curl | sh · zero-width unicode · over-broad MCP scopes

div.style: color: rgb(22, 33, 46) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
T1 — Dataflow / taint
multi-line, in bundled shell scripts
tainted SOURCE → propagate across lines → dangerous SINK
intra-file (ADR-006) + cross-file via source (ADR-007)

div.style: color: rgb(22, 33, 46) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
T3 — Temporal / rug-pull
diff current scan vs an approved .skillsentry.lock
NOT a rule — needs two inputs (fresh + baseline)
capability-fingerprint diff · additive-only (ADR-008)

div.style: color: rgb(106, 114, 124) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

T2 — Semantic (claims-vs-behaviour)
would need an LLM → breaks offline + determinism
NOT built; reserved as a future OPT-IN tier
